subject: history

items.q: Has Britain always had a professional police force?
items.correct: No — the Metropolitan Police began in 1829; before that, parish constables and watchmen kept order.
items.misconception: Yes, organised police have always existed.
items.random_wrong: Policing began only in the 21st century.
items.why: Law enforcement changed greatly over time, with modern policing a 19th-century development.

items.q: Have crimes and punishments stayed the same through history?
items.correct: No — they changed with society, religion and government.
items.random_wrong: Punishments have always been prison sentences.
items.why: Examples include witchcraft trials, the 'Bloody Code' and the later abolition of the death penalty.

specSource: Pearson Edexcel GCSE History (1HI0) specification; Crime & Punishment c1000-Present & Whitechapel c1870-1900
